newsitem.title: USA: Kerr Group in talks about sale of company.
newsitem.headline: Kerr Group in talks about sale of company.

text.p: Kerr Group Inc said Monday that it is engaged in discussions with several third parties regarding a possible sale of the company.
Kerr said it is also continuing its negotiations with certain lenders concerning a restructuring of its debt.
Kerr said it issued a news release about the talks in response to recent trading activity in its common stock and preferred stock.
The stock was up 1/2 at 4-1/4 in mid-afternoon trading Monday.
The company said it intends to make no further comment or release regarding the possible sale of the company unless a definitive agreement is reached or all discussions are terminated.
Kerr is a producer of plastic packaging products.
